verdict.rationale: AutoGen supports assigning specific tool sets to each agent (autogen-docs-1) and documents running code/teams inside Docker containers for isolation, with community confirmation that a new Docker container is spun up per code execution (autogen-docs-15, autogen-comm-2). However, there is no documented fine-grained permission system (e.g., per-tool allow/deny lists, scoped credentials) and the sandboxing default can be disabled, with community members questioning how safe it really is. Missing for 10: explicit tool-permission/ACL framework, documentation of sandbox security guarantees beyond 'docker container per execution', and independent security audit or hands-on validation of sandbox robustness.
